capabilities: Browse repositories, issues, and pull requests in a sidebar panel
Filter issues by state and label with pagination
Create a GitHub issue from the current note or selected text
Auto-refresh data on a configurable interval
extras: Freemium: the GitHub module is free; premium modules (Claude Code bridge, audio notebook sync, AI router) are in development and unlocked by a one-time license. Desktop only. Not yet in the community plugin listing, so install is via BRAT or manual download.
motivation: The author built it to close the gap when project notes and project code live in different windows.
problem: Project notes and GitHub activity live in separate windows, so triaging issues or filing one from a note means leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: The plugin calls the GitHub API (api.github.com) to list repositories, issues, and pull requests
Licenses are validated against the Lemon Squeezy API

requires.name: GitHub personal access token with repo scope
Premium license (Lemon Squeezy) for in-development modules

summary: GitHub client in a sidebar that browses repositories, issues, and pull requests, and creates GitHub issues from note content.
